profile.headline: Frontend Engineer · React, Next.js, TypeScript · Design systems, data viz & polished UI · 6+ years across healthcare, edtech & more
profile.summary:
I'm a senior frontend engineer with tech lead experience, focused on React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I currently build healthcare provider tools at Nuna — owning features end-to-end across a React 19 frontend and a Kotlin/Spring Boot backend — with a 7+ year track record across healthcare and ed-tech platforms used by tens of thousands of clinicians, educators, and students.
 
Career highlights:
 
Healthcare delivery at Nuna: Owned the provider-to-patient kudos recognition feature (2,000+ kudos sent at 98% delivery success) and designed the CGM (continuous glucose monitoring) frontend/backend contract plus AGP time-in-ranges visualization in Recharts.
 
UI craft: Production-grade polish on micro-interactions, loading and error states, and accessible interfaces using React, Mantine, TanStack Query, Recharts, Framer Motion, and GSAP.
 
Scaling impact: Secured district approvals and compliance certifications for ed-tech platforms adopted by 50K+ students and educators across NY and LAUSD.
 
Technical modernization: Migrated a 40K+ LOC Next.js codebase to TypeScript, cutting runtime errors by 30% and re-architecting the frontend for long-term maintainability.
 
Engineering leadership: Directed teams of 5–8 engineers, instituted coding standards and mentorship programs, and set up CI/CD with semantic-release, Docker, and GitHub Actions plus Datadog observability.
 
I'm drawn to teams where engineering and design work closely together, and where the bar for how a product feels is as high as the bar for how it works.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Owned end-to-end delivery of the provider-to-patient kudos recognition feature — 2,000+ messages sent at a 98% delivery success rate — building a multistep compose wizard with bilingual EN/ES support, S3-backed signature and avatar management with checksum verification, and bulk patient workflows
across a Next.js/TypeScript frontend and Kotlin/Spring Boot backend.

- Won Nuna’s company-wide hackathon with a prototype that used AI to transcribe provider–patient calls into personalized care goals, integrating the production kudos system as the recognition layer for AI-generated care plans. 

- Shipped provider-portal features behind Statsig feature flags, rolling out to a pilot org first to gather real user feedback and iterate before broader release — de-risking launches and shortening the path from idea to validated change. 

- Drove the API contract between frontend and backend for the CGM (continuous glucose monitoring) summary feature, then built the clinical time-in-ranges visualization with goal reference lines in Recharts — projected to reach 30% adoption among target patients. 

- Designed and delivered Nuna’s company-wide Next.js/React training curriculum, accelerating engineers from iOS, backend, and other disciplines into crossfunctional contributors as the org transitioned to full-stack ownership. 

- Cleared for production on-call rotation in three months — half the standard onboarding window — covering incident response across the provider experience platform.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Drove engineering compliance for district approvals in NY & LAUSD, ensuring student privacy/security compliance for large-scale deployments.

- Built and launched interactive assessment workflows and curriculum tools, increasing educator efficiency and student engagement tracking.

- Instituted GitHub Projects workflow standards and Datadog observability, providing real-time visibility for leadership and cutting miscommunication.

- Owned roadmap execution across frontend/backend teams, aligning delivery with business goals and shipping multiple releases on time.

positions.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Led TypeScript migration and re-architected frontend for maintainability, improving dev velocity and reducing bugs.

- Developed proprietary code editor + rich-text authoring tools for compliance-critical environments.

- Established coding standards, code reviews, and team mentorship, cutting production issues by 30% while raising team output.

- Integrated Datadog RUM monitoring to enhance performance visibility and early detection of regressions.
positions.insights: Observability (Datadog RUM), Rich Text Editors (TIptap/Markdown) and +5 skills

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Solely managed and maintained Next.js platform during critical transition period, ensuring zero downtime and uninterrupted progress.

- Simplified educator onboarding via SSO with NextAuth, reducing teacher admin overhead by 20%+.

- Introduced Material-UI component library, standardizing design and achieving WCAG compliance across the app.
positions.insights: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), GraphQL and +5 skills

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Lead a small team for site refreshes/redesigns concentrating on user experience resulting in cleaner, more maintainable sites

- Reduced bounce rate by 35% and increased perceived performance by 300% resulting in more orders being placed

- Coordinated a team of two developers and two designers to implement and launch sites that connected distributor clients to consumers during Covid-19

- Managed reusable components to integrate to CMS reducing developer time and allowing client and designer handling

- Built RESTful web-services ensuring front end best practices achieving 100% integration, unit, and end-to-end test results

- Perform site performance tests using third party tools like Lambda and SpeedCurve to determine any bottlenecks or potential areas of improvements and evaluate trade-offs

- Consulted with clients to establish sites were pixel-perfect, responsive, and tested for 99% user compatibility

- Provided feedback to designer and client, relying on analytical data, on more engaging designs and user experiences improving site interactions

- Increased accessibility by adhering to WCAG standards improving accessibility page points by over 40%
